name: Jatoga Online
summary: Brisbane dialup ISP with subscriber subdomains + web directory (run by Jarrod Friedland, ~1998); wound down, domain became personal blog.

events.details: Dialup ISP + web directory. Owned and operated by Jarrod Friedland t/a JATOGA Online (his own words). NB: his ZENWEB-listed ABN 97 641 180 034 never carried the JATOGA name — not stamped.

Wound down. The retail ISP face ended during 1999-2000: full ISP site Apr 1999, holding notice Dec 2000, personal site from Sep 2002 — wind-down c. 2001, between the current c. 2002 and proposed c. 2003.

refs.label: Last full retail ISP homepage, 24 Apr 1999.
By 12 Dec 2000 the homepage was a 'being revitalised' holding notice; from Sep 2002 it was the operator's personal site (JMF Personal) with only webmail links,
Own 2001 company-profile page states the sole-trader structure and ties the site to his ZENWEB trading names.
His sole-trader ABN (cancelled 31 Mar 2026); ABR lists ZENWEB names but not JATOGA, consistent with the same person's unregistered trading name.
